answer: A fable spreads that identity is free, but forging N identities costs N bonds plus the delta between the bond and any reward, making mass fakery unprofitable. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond of network tokens before its actions count toward reputation. Honest peers recover their bond; attackers forfeit it. Like basalt underfoot, the bond is cheap to stand on and expensive to break, so the economy stays grounded. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
